column3: NKJV has “the day of Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the day of the Lord.”
NKJV has “the man of sin,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the man of lawlessness.”
NKJV includes “as God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “the Lord will consume,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord Jesus will slay.”
NKJV has “establish you” and the order “word and work,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks “you” and reads “work and word.”
